items.title: US-Iran ceasefire leaves Israelis feeling sidelined, their war aims unachieved
items.description: The U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal leaves many Israelis feeling vulnerable and abandoned by their most important ally. They voiced concern for Israel’s security, and some criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for failing to achieve his war aims.

items.title: What led a teenager and her boyfriend to kill her grandparents: 'They wanted to stop us from living our love'
items.description: On March 31, François and Danielle, a beloved couple in their 70s, were found dead in their home in northern France. Their 16-year-old granddaughter and her 15-year-old boyfriend confessed to the double premeditated murder.
